name: basketball-stars-online
description: Online 1v1 lobby and input relay for the original Basketball Legends 2019 game

scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p engine-source /tmp/basketball-engine && unzip -oq BasketballStarsUnblocked.github.io-main.zip -d /tmp/basketball-engine && cp -a /tmp/basketball-engine/BasketballStarsUnblocked.github.io-main/. engine-source/ && rm -rf /tmp/basketball-engine && node scripts/patch-original-game.js
